answer: A concrete way to resist sybil attacks is to price new influence in both capital and calendar time. Each fresh key locks a modest onyx bond and remains politically light until that bond has sat untouched through a long tundra of epochs, while independent peers attest that its work is original. The agent may wander the market and post immediately, but votes and grades stay discounted until the delay is served. Because every extra persona repeats the same lock and wait, mass-minted identities stay cheap to ignore and expensive to operate.
